name: Footnotes
description: A collection of Footnote objects that represent all the footnotes in a selection, range, or document.
remarks: Use the Footnotes property to return the Footnotes collection. The following example changes all of the footnotes in the active document to endnotes. Use the Add method to add a footnote to the Footnotes collection. The following example adds a footnote immediately after the selection. Use Footnotes (index), where index is the index number, to return a single Footnote object. The index number represents the position of the footnote in the selection, range, or document. The following example applies red formatting to the first footnote in the selection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of footnotes in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Footnotes object.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of all footnotes. Read/write WdFootnoteLocation.

properties.name: NumberStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the number style for the footnotes. Read/write WdNoteNumberStyle.

properties.name: StartingNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the starting note number, line number, or page number. Read/write Long.

properties.name: NumberingRule
properties.description: Returns or sets the way footnotes or endnotes are numbered after page breaks or section breaks. Read/write WdNumberingRule.

properties.name: Separator
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the footnote separator.

properties.name: ContinuationSeparator
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the footnote continuation separator. Read-only.

properties.name: ContinuationNotice
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the footnote continuation notice. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Footnote object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, [Reference As Variant], [Text As Variant]) As Footnote
methods.description: Returns a Footnote object that represents a footnote added to a range.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range marked for the endnote or footnote. This can be a collapsed range.

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: The text for the custom reference mark. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Word inserts an automatically-numbered reference mark.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text of the endnote or footnote.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts endnotes to footnotes, or vice versa.

methods.name: SwapWithEndnotes
methods.description: Converts all footnotes in a document to endnotes and vice versa.To convert a range of footnotes to endnotes, use the Convert method.

methods.name: ResetSeparator
methods.description: Resets the footnote separator to the default separator.

methods.name: ResetContinuationSeparator
methods.description: Resets the footnote or endnote continuation separator to the default separator.

methods.name: ResetContinuationNotice
methods.description: Resets the footnote or endnote continuation notice to the default notice.
